modelOverview: The Rolex Yacht-Master 40 is the nautically inspired sports model that blends the robustness of an Oyster Professional watch with refined precious-metal styling. Introduced in its modern 40mm guise, it is defined by a bidirectional rotatable 60-minute graduated bezel with raised numerals and is offered across Rolesium, Everose Rolesor and solid Everose gold executions. It is powered by Rolex's Calibre 3235 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve.

126622.materials: Oystersteel case with 950 platinum bezel; Oystersteel Oyster bracelet (Rolesium)
126622.bezel: Bidirectional rotatable 60-minute graduated bezel in 950 platinum with raised numerals
126622.dial: Dark rhodium dial with Chromalight-filled hour markers and hands
126622.description: The Yacht-Master 40 Ref. 126622 is the 'Rolesium' configuration, pairing an Oystersteel case with a distinctive bidirectional 950 platinum bezel for a silvery, understated luxury. Its dark rhodium dial with raised numerals on the bezel is the model's signature look. Each example is sourced and fully authenticated.

variants.Rhodium: Rolesium execution in Oystersteel with a 950 platinum bidirectional bezel and a dark rhodium sunburst dial, finished on an Oystersteel Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock clasp and Easylink extension.

126621.materials: Everose Rolesor: Oystersteel case and 18ct Everose gold; Everose Rolesor Oyster bracelet
126621.bezel: Bidirectional rotatable 60-minute graduated bezel in 18ct Everose gold with polished raised numerals
126621.dial: Chocolate sunray dial with luminous hour markers and hands
126621.description: The Yacht-Master 40 Ref. 126621 is the Everose Rolesor two-tone, combining Oystersteel with 18ct Everose gold and topped by a warm chocolate sunray dial. Its Everose gold bezel with polished raised numerals gives it a softer, richer character than the steel models. Each example is sourced and fully authenticated.

variants.Steel & Rose: Everose Rolesor two-tone in Oystersteel and 18ct Everose gold, with an Everose gold bidirectional bezel and a signature chocolate sunray dial, on the matching Everose Rolesor Oyster bracelet.

126655.materials: 18ct Everose gold case; Oysterflex bracelet with 18ct Everose gold Oysterlock clasp
126655.bezel: Bidirectional rotatable 60-minute graduated bezel with matt black Cerachrom ceramic insert and polished raised numerals
126655.dial: Intense black dial with Chromalight-filled markers and hands
126655.description: The Yacht-Master 40 Ref. 126655 is the solid 18ct Everose gold model matched to the sporty Oysterflex bracelet, blending precious metal with elastomer-clad flexibility. Its black Cerachrom ceramic bezel and intense black dial give it a bold, contemporary presence. Each example is sourced and fully authenticated.

variants.Rose Gold Oysterflex: Solid 18ct Everose gold case with a matt black Cerachrom ceramic bezel and intense black dial, mounted on the high-performance Oysterflex bracelet with an 18ct Everose gold Oysterlock clasp.
